decisions.reason: The hearty bread loaf draws directly on the firm's long baking tradition and craft knowledge, so management can readily read its early sales and adjust the recipe without outside research.

The historic mill tour extends the firm's existing hospitality and event facilities and its heritage story, so it uses resources and knowledge the firm already holds, though tour demand is less familiar to interpret than bakery sales.

The sweet pastry sits squarely within the firm's confectionery expertise, letting it absorb customer feedback and refine the product in-house, although seasonal or assortment rotation creates some risk of replacement.
